visual_identity.core_identity: A refuse-dwelling aberration with three stout legs, two long grasping tentacles, one elevated eyestalk, and a broad central mouth.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low bulky central body supported by three legs, two long tentacles reaching outward, and one eye stalk rising above.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; one elevated eye and a huge mouth with blunt irregular teeth occupy the central body.
visual_identity.body_shape: Round heavy torso with three thick legs and two flexible grasping tentacles.
visual_identity.surface: Tough hide with sparse folds and warts kept simple.
